result.instructions: Tools for DialMyCalls, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many credits are left on my DialMyCalls account?"; "Show my last 10 text broadcasts and how many were delivered."; "List the contacts in my Volunteers group.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes DialMyCalls data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run dialmycalls_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dialmycalls_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dialmycalls_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. dialmycalls_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dialmycalls_get_account
tools.title: Get DialMyCalls account
tools.description: Get the account: credits available (calls and texts spend credits) and the account creation date.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts in the account (name, phone, email, groups), 100 per page.

start.description: First record to return, 1-based (default 1). Use next_start from the previous reply to get the next page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_contacts_in_group
tools.title: List contacts in a group
tools.description: List the contacts that belong to one contact group (from dialmycalls_list_groups), 100 per page.

start.description: First record to return, 1-based (default 1). Use next_start from the previous reply to get the next page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id.

tools.name: dialmycalls_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Add a contact (phone number required) to the contact list, optionally into contact groups. Sends nothing to the contact.

group_ids.description: Contact groups the contact belongs to (from dialmycalls_list_groups).

tools.name: dialmycalls_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Update a contact. DialMyCalls requires the phone number on every update. Fields you omit are left as they are; if you pass group_ids the contact's groups are REPLACED by that list.

group_ids.description: Contact groups the contact belongs to (from dialmycalls_list_groups).

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_groups

tools.description: List contact groups with their contact counts, 100 per page.

start.description: First record to return, 1-based (default 1). Use next_start from the previous reply to get the next page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_get_group

tools.description: Get one contact group (name, contacts_count) by id.

tools.name: dialmycalls_create_group
tools.title: Create a contact group
tools.description: Create an empty contact group. Sends nothing.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_recordings
tools.title: List voice recordings
tools.description: List voice recordings (the messages a call broadcast can play): id, name, type, length, processed. A call needs a processed recording.

start.description: First record to return, 1-based (default 1). Use next_start from the previous reply to get the next page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_get_recording
tools.title: Get a recording
tools.description: Get one voice recording by id (includes its audio file url and whether it is processed and ready).

tools.name: dialmycalls_create_recording_tts
tools.title: Create a text-to-speech recording
tools.description: Create a voice recording from text (text-to-speech) that a call broadcast can then play. Makes no call and sends nothing.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_caller_ids
tools.title: List caller IDs
tools.description: List caller ID phone numbers on the account (id, name, phone, approved). A call broadcast needs an approved caller ID.

start.description: First record to return, 1-based (default 1). Use next_start from the previous reply to get the next page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_keywords
tools.title: List text keywords
tools.description: List text-message keywords (id, keyword, status). A text broadcast must be tied to one active keyword.

start.description: First record to return, 1-based (default 1). Use next_start from the previous reply to get the next page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_shortcodes

tools.description: List shortcodes available to send texts from.

start.description: First record to return, 1-based (default 1). Use next_start from the previous reply to get the next page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_do_not_contacts
tools.title: List do-not-contact numbers
tools.description: List phone numbers on the account's do-not-contact lists (type call or text); these opted out.

start.description: First record to return, 1-based (default 1). Use next_start from the previous reply to get the next page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_calls

tools.name: dialmycalls_send_call
tools.title: Send a voice call broadcast (spends credits)
tools.description: Send (or schedule) an automated VOICE CALL broadcast that plays a recording to real people. THIS SPENDS ACCOUNT CREDITS AND PHONES THE RECIPIENTS; it cannot be undone once it goes out (a scheduled one can be stopped with dialmycalls_cancel_call). Needs an approved caller_id (dialmycalls_list_caller_ids) and a processed recording (dialmycalls_list_recordings or dialmycalls_create_recording_tts). Ask the user to approve the recipients, recording and time first; with confirm false nothing is sent and a preview is returned.

callerid_id.description: Caller ID to call from (an approved one from dialmycalls_list_caller_ids).

recipients.description: People to send to, by phone number (up to 1000). Give recipients, group_id, or both.

phone.description: Phone number, e.g. 5555555555 (spaces, dashes and a leading + are allowed).

group_id.description: Send to every contact in this contact group (from dialmycalls_list_groups); contacts without a phone number are skipped.

send_at.description: When to send, an ISO 8601 date-time WITH time zone (e.g. 2026-11-05T14:00:00-05:00). Omit to send immediately.

confirm.description: MUST be true to send. Set it to true ONLY after the user has explicitly approved the recipients and content in this conversation. With false the tool sends nothing and returns a preview.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_text_recipients

start.description: First record to return, 1-based (default 1). Use next_start from the previous reply to get the next page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_send_text
tools.title: Send a text (SMS) broadcast (spends credits)
tools.description: Send (or schedule) a TEXT MESSAGE (SMS) broadcast to real people. THIS SPENDS ACCOUNT CREDITS AND TEXTS THE RECIPIENTS; it cannot be undone once it goes out (a scheduled one can be stopped with dialmycalls_cancel_text). Needs an active keyword (dialmycalls_list_keywords). Up to 10 messages per broadcast. Ask the user to approve the recipients, wording and time first; with confirm false nothing is sent and a preview is returned.

keyword_id.description: The keyword to tie the broadcast to (an active one from dialmycalls_list_keywords).

messages.description: The message texts (1-10, each up to 1600 characters).

shortcode_id.description: Send from this shortcode (from dialmycalls_list_shortcodes); default: the account's number.

concatenate_sms.description: Combine all messages into one on the recipient's phone.

recipients.description: People to send to, by phone number (up to 1000). Give recipients, group_id, or both.

phone.description: Phone number, e.g. 5555555555 (spaces, dashes and a leading + are allowed).

group_id.description: Send to every contact in this contact group (from dialmycalls_list_groups); contacts without a phone number are skipped.

send_at.description: When to send, an ISO 8601 date-time WITH time zone (e.g. 2026-11-05T14:00:00-05:00). Omit to send immediately.

confirm.description: MUST be true to send. Set it to true ONLY after the user has explicitly approved the recipients and content in this conversation. With false the tool sends nothing and returns a preview.

tools.name: dialmycalls_cancel_text
tools.title: Cancel a text broadcast
tools.description: Cancel an outgoing or scheduled text broadcast that has not finished. Texts already sent are not undone.

tools.name: dialmycalls_list_incoming_texts
tools.title: List incoming texts
tools.description: List text messages people sent to the account's numbers (from, to, message, time), 100 per page.

start.description: First record to return, 1-based (default 1). Use next_start from the previous reply to get the next page.

tools.name: dialmycalls_get_incoming_text
tools.title: Get an incoming text
tools.description: Get one incoming text message by id.
